title: Penn Station map: build Moynihan Train Hall?

questions.title: Moynihan Train Hall in the 1910 map
questions.question: Should the 1910 Penn Station map also get Moynihan Train Hall (opened 2021)?
questions.why: It decides what the last 12 chain sessions build. Moynihan is a different era, so it is a scope change.
questions.background: gm_penn_station 0.6.0 has all six planned 1910 areas: waiting room, arcade, concourse, platforms with trains, exterior, dining and lunch rooms. The plan listed Moynihan Train Hall as an extra if the budget allows. Budget used: 26,778 of 65,536 vertices, 45.8 of 150 MB. A separate chain (penn-modern-gmod) is already building the present-day station, which is where Moynihan fits best.

options.label: No: polish the 1910 station instead
options.consequence: Remaining sessions fix the clock figures, window glass, the too-long avenue front, waiting-room attic, wiki.

options.label: No here, but add it to the penn-modern-gmod map
options.consequence: A note goes to that chain's plan.

options.label: Yes: build it in this map as a separate wing
options.consequence: About 8 sessions; mixes 1910 and 2021 in one map.

guess.why: The present-day chain is the natural home; mixing eras in one map breaks the 1910 look.
